### 11.2 File, Component, Hook, API & Service Inventory

| File Path | Type / Role | Primary Export / Target | Port / Network Boundary | Forensic Responsibility |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `Dockerfile` | Multi-Stage Build Specification | Next.js Standalone Container Image | Exposes Port 3000 (Internal) | Produces minimal `node:22-alpine` production runner image, executes `npm run build` standalone output, runs as unprivileged user `nextjs` (UID 1001), configures 30s liveness healthcheck. |
| `server/Dockerfile` | Multi-Stage Build Specification | WebSocket Realtime Container Image | Exposes Port 3001 (WS) & 9090 (Health) | Builds dedicated TypeScript realtime server, strips heavy Next.js frontend dependencies, runs as unprivileged user `itms` (UID 10001), configures 15s liveness probe against Port 9090. |
| `docker-compose.yml` | Container Orchestration (Dev/Staging) | Local Multi-Container Transit Stack | Ports 80, 443, 3000, 3001, 6379, 9090, 9093, 3002 | Declares `redis`, `ws1`, `nextjs`, `nginx`, `prometheus`, `alertmanager`, and `grafana` services on bridged `itms` network. Mounts host source volumes for hot development. |
| `docker-compose.prod.yml` | Container Orchestration (Production) | Production Hardened Transit Stack | Ports 80, 443, 3001, 3000, 9090, 9093, 3002 | Production orchestration with strict memory limits (Redis: 512M, WS: 1536M, Next.js: 1024M), mandatory `GF_ADMIN_PASSWORD` assertion, Redis password authentication, persistent named volumes. |
| `nginx/nginx.conf` | Edge Reverse Proxy Configuration | NGINX Edge Ingress & TLS Termination | Ports 80 (Redirect) & 443 (SSL/HTTP2) | Enforces TLS 1.2/1.3 with modern AEAD ciphers, HSTS, X-Frame-Options: DENY, 24h WebSocket proxy timeouts (`86400s`), round-robin Next.js upstream, and internal IP guards for `/health` and `/metrics`. |
| `src/lib/supabase-server.ts` | Database Client Singleton | `getSupabaseServer()` | Outbound HTTPS to Supabase Cloud | Initializes process-wide Supabase client using `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, disables auth session persistence, wraps fetch in 10s AbortSignal timeout, provides build-time Proxy guard. |
| `src/lib/supabase-client.ts` | Browser Anon Database Client | `supabase`, `db` | Browser-side HTTPS to Supabase Cloud | Initializes browser client using public anon key, gracefully warns on missing env vars during client-side hydration. |
| `server/redis-client.ts` | Raw TCP/TLS Redis Driver | `redisClient`, `ResilientRedisClient` | Outbound TCP/TLS to Redis Port 6379 | Zero-dependency native Node.js TCP/TLS Redis client with independent pub/sub sockets, generation tracking, pipelined re-subscriptions, reconnect jitter, and RESP parser. |
| `server/redis-pubsub.ts` | Pub/Sub Protocol Adapter | `redisPubSub`, `RedisPubSub` | In-Process Adapter Interface | Adapts `redisClient` to `PubSubAdapter` interface, routing `publish`, `subscribe`, and `unsubscribe` calls to the active TCP client. |
| `server/redis-broadcast.ts` | Security Bridge & Cross-Node Relay | `MY_NODE_ID`, `initRedisBroadcastRelay` | Redis Channels: `role_invalidate`, etc. | Subscribes to cross-process role invalidation and student entitlement updates, terminates unauthorized client WebSocket connections with custom RFC 6455 codes (4401, 4402). |
| `server/index.ts` | Realtime Cluster Entrypoint | Main Server Process Execution | Inbound Ports 3001 (WS) & 9090 (Health) | Boots dual HTTP servers (main WS engine and dedicated health/metrics server), manages graceful shutdown with 30s connection draining, handles uncaught exceptions. |

### 11.3 Method-by-Method Low-Level Walkthrough

#### 1. `Dockerfile` (Root Next.js Application)
- **Stage 1 (`deps` lines 2–12)**:
  - Base: `node:22-alpine`. Installs `libc6-compat` for native compatibility.
  - Environment: Sets `NPM_CONFIG_LOGLEVEL=error`, `NPM_CONFIG_FUND=false`, `NPM_CONFIG_AUDIT=false`, `NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false` to minimize console noise and CPU usage.
  - Dependency Install: Mounts cache target `/root/.npm` and executes `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --no-fund --no-audit` with fallback to `npm install`.
- **Stage 2 (`builder` lines 15–75)**:
  - Copies `node_modules` from `deps` stage and entire source tree.
  - Declares all public build arguments (`ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_*`) required by Next.js client bundling.
  - Injects fallback CI values for all required environment variables (including placeholder private keys and secrets) to allow Next.js tree-shaking and static route compilation during container builds.
  - Mounts build cache target `/app/.next/cache` and executes `npm run build`.
- **Stage 3 (`runner` lines 78–108)**:
  - Base: `node:22-alpine`. Configures unprivileged system group `nodejs` (GID 1001) and system user `nextjs` (UID 1001).
  - Copies public directory and standalone bundle: `/app/.next/standalone` and `/app/.next/static`.
  - Sets file ownership to `nextjs:nodejs` and transitions to `USER nextjs`.
  - Configures container `HEALTHCHECK`: Probes `http://localhost:3000/api/health` every 30s with 5s timeout, 15s start period, and 3 retries.
  - Entrypoint: `CMD ["node", "server.js"]`.

#### 2. `server/Dockerfile` (Dedicated WebSocket Server)
- **Stage 1 (`builder` lines 2–17)**:
  - Base: `node:22-alpine`. Sets `PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=true`.
  - Installs dependencies via `npm install --legacy-peer-deps` and explicitly purges heavy frontend packages (`puppeteer`, `next`, `tailwindcss`, `recharts`, `framer-motion`, `exceljs`, `jspdf`, etc.) to minimize image footprint.
  - Copies `server/`, `src/`, and `tsconfig.json`.
- **Stage 2 (`runner` lines 20–46)**:
  - Creates unprivileged group `itms` (GID 10001) and user `itms` (UID 10001).
  - Copies builder artifacts with ownership `--chown=itms:itms`.
  - Transitions to `USER itms`. Exposes Ports 3001 and 9090.
  - Configures `HEALTHCHECK`: Probes `http://localhost:9090/health/live` every 15s with 5s timeout, 10s start period, and 3 retries.
  - Entrypoint: `CMD ["npx", "tsx", "server/index.ts"]`.

#### 3. `docker-compose.prod.yml` (Production Stack Orchestration)
- **Service `redis` (lines 4–26)**:
  - Image: `redis:7.2-alpine`.
  - Command: `redis-server --save 60 1 --loglevel notice ${REDIS_PASSWORD:+--requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD}}`. Enforces password authentication in production if `REDIS_PASSWORD` is set.
  - Volume: `redis-data:/data` for RDB persistence.
  - Healthcheck: `redis-cli ping` every 10s.
  - Resource Limit: Capped at `memory: 512M`.
- **Service `ws1` (lines 28–58)**:
  - Container: `itms-ws1`. Binds port `127.0.0.1:3001:3001` (local binding; NGINX reverse-proxies traffic).
  - Environment: `WS_PORT=3001`, `HEALTH_PORT=9090`, `REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379`.
  - Depends On: `redis` (`condition: service_healthy`).
  - Graceful Shutdown: `stop_grace_period: 40s` (ensures Node.js 30s connection draining completes before SIGKILL).
  - Resource Limit: Capped at `memory: 1536M`.
- **Service `nextjs` (lines 60–85)**:
  - Container: `itms-nextjs`. Binds port `127.0.0.1:3000:3000`.
  - Healthcheck: `wget --spider http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health?liveness=1` every 20s.
  - Resource Limit: Capped at `memory: 1024M`.
- **Service `nginx` (lines 87–103)**:
  - Image: `nginx:1.27-alpine`. Binds host ports `80:80` and `443:443`.
  - Mounts configuration `./nginx/nginx.conf` and certificates `./nginx/certs`.
  - Depends On: `ws1` and `nextjs` with `condition: service_healthy`.
- **Monitoring Stack (`prometheus`, `alertmanager`, `grafana` lines 105–154)**:
  - Grafana enforces `GF_ADMIN_PASSWORD:?GF_ADMIN_PASSWORD must be set in .env` to prevent deployment with default credentials.
  - Binds internal ports to `127.0.0.1`.

#### 4. `nginx/nginx.conf` (Edge Reverse Proxy Engine)
- **Core Directives (lines 1–5)**:
  - `worker_connections 4096;`, `multi_accept on;`, `use epoll;`.
- **Security & Compression (lines 7–34)**:
  - `server_tokens off;`, `client_max_body_size 10M;`.
  - Gzip enabled with level 6 for all modern text/json/xml MIME types.
  - TLS: Enforces `TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3` with ECDHE and ChaCha20 cipher suites. Enables SSL session caching (`shared:SSL:10m`, 1 day timeout) and OCSP stapling.
  - Security Headers: HSTS with 2-year preload (`max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload`), `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, and `Permissions-Policy`.
- **Upstream Groups (lines 35–58)**:
  - `ws_backend`: Points to `ws1:3001` with `keepalive 256`.
  - `nextjs_backend`: Points to `nextjs:3000` with `least_conn` balancing and `keepalive 64`.
  - `health_backend`: Points to `ws1:9090` with `keepalive 16`.
- **Server Blocks (lines 60–175)**:
  - Port 80: HTTP to HTTPS 301 permanent redirect with ACME challenge passthrough.
  - Port 443: HTTPS with HTTP/2.
  - Location `/ws`: Proxies to `http://ws_backend`. Sets `Upgrade` and `Connection: upgrade` headers. Configures `proxy_read_timeout 86400s` and `proxy_send_timeout 86400s`. Disables buffering and caching.
  - Location `/health` & `/metrics`: Internal only. Restricts access via `allow 127.0.0.1;`, `allow 10.0.0.0/8;`, `allow 172.16.0.0/12;`, `allow 192.168.0.0/16;`, `deny all;`.
  - Location `= /api/admin/alerts` & `= /api/metrics`: Restricted to internal monitoring subnet.
  - Location `/`: Proxies to `http://nextjs_backend` with 30s read timeout and 10s connect timeout.

#### 5. `src/lib/supabase-server.ts` (Supabase Server Singleton)
- **Singleton Variable**: `let _serverClient: SupabaseClient | null = null;`.
- **`getSupabaseServer()` Function**:
  - Resolves `url` from `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` or `SUPABASE_URL`.
  - Resolves `key` from `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` or `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`.
  - **Build-Time Proxy Guard**: If `url` or `key` are missing, returns a `new Proxy({}, { get(target, prop) { throw new Error(...); } })`. This allows Next.js static asset bundling to complete without environment variables, failing closed only if code tries to query the database.
  - **Client Initialization**: Calls `createClient(url, key, options)`:
    - `auth.autoRefreshToken = false`
    - `auth.persistSession = false`
    - `global.fetch`: Wraps default fetch with `signal: init?.signal || AbortSignal.timeout(10000)` to enforce 10s maximum query duration.
    - `realtime: { params: { eventsPerSecond: 0 } }`: Disables Supabase Realtime WebSocket overhead on server API routes.
  - Returns cached `_serverClient`.

#### 6. `src/lib/supabase-client.ts` (Supabase Client Anon Instance)
- Reads `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`.
- Logs client error if missing in browser context.
- Exports singleton `supabase` and alias `db` via `createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey)`.

#### 7. `server/redis-client.ts` (Resilient Redis Client)
- **Class `ResilientRedisClient`**:
  - Manages `clientSocket` and `subSocket` (`net.Socket | tls.TLSSocket`).
  - `parseUrl(urlStr)`: Parses Redis connection string (`redis://` or `rediss://`), extracts host, port, TLS flag, username, and password.
  - `connect()`: Connects `clientSocket`. Increments `this.generation`. Invokes `net.createConnection` or `tls.connect`. Sets TCP keepalive to 30,000ms. Dispatches `AUTH` command if credentials exist. Schedules reconnect with jitter on error/close.
  - `initSubSocket()`: Increments `this.subGeneration`. Establishes separate connection for subscriptions. Pipelines `AUTH` and all active `SUBSCRIBE <channel>` commands into a single TCP write. On close, rate-limits socket recovery to once every 2,000ms.
  - `parseRespMessages(buffer)`: Zero-copy state machine parsing raw Redis Serialization Protocol byte streams. Decodes 3-element array frames matching `*3\r\n$7\r\nmessage\r\n$<ch_len>\r\n<channel>\r\n$<msg_len>\r\n<message>` and dispatches to registered handler callbacks.
  - `scheduleReconnect()`: Sets timer for `5000ms + random(0..2000ms)` jitter to prevent thundering herd reconnection storms against Redis.
  - `publish(channel, message)`: Encodes RESP command `['PUBLISH', channel, message]` and writes to `clientSocket`.
  - `subscribe(channel, handler)`: Registers handler in `pubSubHandlers` Map. If newly subscribed, writes RESP `['SUBSCRIBE', channel]` to `subSocket`.
  - `unsubscribe(channel)`: Removes handlers and transmits `['UNSUBSCRIBE', channel]`.

#### 8. `server/redis-pubsub.ts` & `server/redis-broadcast.ts`
- **`RedisPubSub` Class**: Implements `PubSubAdapter` interface (`publish`, `subscribe`, `unsubscribe`) by delegating to `redisClient`.
- **`initRedisBroadcastRelay()`**:
  - Subscribes to `role_invalidate` and `itms:roles:invalidate`:
    - Calls `invalidateTokenAuthCache(uid)`.
    - Invokes `clearStudentPresenceCache(uid)`.
    - Retrieves active sessions from `sessionManager.getByUid(uid)`.
    - Closes matching WebSockets via `conn.ws.close(4401, 'Role revoked or permissions modified - please re-authenticate')`.
    - Unregisters from `connectionRegistry` and deletes session.
  - Subscribes to `student_assign_invalidate`:
    - Closes student WebSockets via `conn.ws.close(4402, 'Student assignment or transport entitlement updated - reconnecting')`.

#### 9. `server/index.ts` (Realtime Cluster Entrypoint)
- **Environment & Security Gates**:
  - Production gate: Calls `assertPrivilegedTokenSafe()` to ensure `WS_PRIVILEGED_TOKEN` is not using insecure defaults; aborts with `process.exit(1)` on failure.
  - Calls `validateEnvironment({ isWebSocketServer: true })`; aborts on missing critical environment variables.
- **Dual Server Architecture**:
  - Main Server (`server`): Listens on `WS_PORT=3001`. Handles `upgrade` for WebSocket connections, and responds to fallback health/metrics endpoints (`/health`, `/health/live`, `/health/ready`, `/metrics`, `/metrics/json`).
  - Health/Metrics Server (`healthServer`): Listens on `HEALTH_PORT=9090` for dedicated internal Prometheus scraping and container health probes.
- **Graceful Shutdown**:
  - Captures `SIGTERM` and `SIGINT`.
  - Calls `healthService.startShutdown()` and `healthService.startDraining()`.
  - Sets 30s drain timeout (`drainTimeout: 30000`).
  - Invokes `wsServer.shutdown()` to flush pending frames, close client connections, stop offline queues, rate limiters, and message validators, then exits cleanly (`process.exit(0)`).

### 11.4 Exact I/O, Database Query, Redis & External API Count Matrix

| Scenario / Operation | NGINX Reverse Proxy Calls | Docker / OS Kernel I/O | Redis TCP / Socket I/O | Supabase / PostgreSQL Queries | External Provider Calls | Total Network Operations |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Container Cold Boot (Next.js Standalone)** | 0 (Internal) | Node.js process spawn, load standalone server.js, bind 0.0.0.0:3000 | 0 | 0 (Deferred until first API request) | 0 | 0 DB, 0 Net |
| **Container Cold Boot (WS Server Runtime)** | 0 (Internal) | Node.js process spawn, bind :3001 & :9090 | 2 TCP connects (`clientSocket` + `subSocket`), 1 Pipelined SUBSCRIBE | 0 (Auth uses Firebase Admin SDK) | 0 | 2 Redis TCP writes |
| **Client WebSocket Handshake & Session Connect** | 1 Inbound HTTPS -> 1 Upstream Proxy HTTP/1.1 Upgrade | OS epoll socket creation, TLS decryption, WS handshake | 0 (Local memory session registry) | 0 (Token verified via Firebase Admin JWT verify) | 0 (Local public key cache) | 1 Ingress + 1 Upstream Proxy |
| **Realtime Telematics Broadcast (Driver GPS)** | 1 Inbound WS Frame | epoll read -> JSON decode -> memory broadcast to subscribers | 0 (Bypassed in single-node architecture) | 0 (High frequency; GPS buffered in memory) | 0 | 0 DB, 0 Redis |
| **Admin Privilege Revocation Event** | 1 API request to Next.js (`POST /api/admin/users/role`) | Ingress proxy to Next.js :3000 | 1 Redis `PUBLISH role_invalidate <uid>` | 1 SQL `UPDATE user_roles` | 0 | 1 DB Query, 1 Redis Pub |
| **WS Cluster Handling Role Revocation** | 0 | Inbound TCP read on `subSocket` | 1 Redis message read | 0 (Session eviction from local Map) | 0 | 1 TCP read, N socket closures (code 4401) |
| **Server-Side API Supabase Query (Cold Cache)** | 1 Ingress proxy to Next.js :3000 | Node.js worker event loop | 0 | 1 HTTPS REST/RPC query (10s AbortSignal timeout) | 0 | 1 DB REST Call |
| **Server-Side API Supabase Query (Hanging Partition)** | 1 Ingress proxy to Next.js :3000 | Node.js worker event loop | 0 | 1 HTTPS query -> Aborted at exactly 10,000ms | 0 | 1 Aborted DB Call (HTTP 504) |
| **Redis Network Drop & Auto-Recovery** | 0 | TCP disconnect event, generation increment | 2 TCP reconnects with 5–7s jitter, 1 Pipelined AUTH + SUBSCRIBE write | 0 | 0 | 2 Reconnect TCP writes |

```dockerfile
      org.opencontainers.image.vendor="ADTU Bus Services"

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT=3000
ENV HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0"
ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1

RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs
RUN adduser --system --uid 1001 nextjs

COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public

RUN mkdir .next
RUN chown nextjs:nodejs .next

COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/standalone ./
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/static ./.next/static

USER nextjs

EXPOSE 3000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=15s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1

CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```

```dockerfile
# Stage 1: Build & dependency stage
FROM node:22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app

ENV PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=true \
    NPM_CONFIG_LOGLEVEL=error \
    NPM_CONFIG_FUND=false \
    NPM_CONFIG_AUDIT=false \
    NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false

COPY package*.json ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm install --legacy-peer-deps --no-fund --no-audit && \
    rm -rf node_modules/puppeteer node_modules/puppeteer-core node_modules/next node_modules/@next node_modules/vitest node_modules/tailwindcss node_modules/@tailwindcss node_modules/maplibre-gl node_modules/leaflet node_modules/recharts node_modules/framer-motion node_modules/exceljs node_modules/jspdf node_modules/cloudinary

COPY server ./server
COPY src ./src
COPY tsconfig.json ./

# Stage 2: Production runtime stage
FROM node:22-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="ITMS WebSocket Server" \
      org.opencontainers.image.description="Dedicated Realtime Transport Service for ITMS" \
      org.opencontainers.image.vendor="ADTU Bus Services"

RUN addgroup -S -g 10001 itms && adduser -S -u 10001 -G itms itms

COPY --from=builder --chown=itms:itms /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder --chown=itms:itms /app/server ./server
COPY --from=builder --chown=itms:itms /app/src ./src
COPY --from=builder --chown=itms:itms /app/tsconfig.json ./

USER itms

EXPOSE 3001 9090

ENV NODE_ENV=production \
    WS_PORT=3001 \
    HEALTH_PORT=9090

HEALTHCHECK --interval=15s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:9090/health/live || exit 1

CMD ["npx", "tsx", "server/index.ts"]

```

```yaml
      interval: 15s

        NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY:-ci-placeholder}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN:-ci.firebaseapp.com}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID:-ci}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET:-ci.appspot.com}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID:-000000000000}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID:-1:000000000000:web:ci}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL:-https://ci.supabase.co}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-ci}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL:-ws://localhost:3001}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID:-ci}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_ASSET_FOLDER: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_ASSET_FOLDER}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_STAGING: "true"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3000
      - HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # The WebSocket transport (emitEvent -> WebSocketTransport) runs inside the
      # Next.js container and must reach the WS server. Use the Docker service name
      # (ws1), not 127.0.0.1, since the container's loopback does not expose the
      # WS port. The WS_PORT is 3001 inside the container (same as the ws1 service).
      - WS_HOST=ws1
      - WS_PORT=3001
      - WS_SERVER_URL=ws://ws1:3001/ws
      # Staging load-test harness (scripts/staging/master-simulation.ts):
      # STAGING_MODE + LOAD_TEST_SECRET enable the proxy-level IP rate-limit
      # bypass (x-load-test-bypass header) so high-volume simulated users are
      # NOT throttled by the global per-IP DDoS guard. The per-user route-level
      # rate limits (api-security.ts) remain ACTIVE — the harness never bypasses
      # per-user auth/RBAC/business rules.
      - STAGING_MODE=true
      - LOAD_TEST_SECRET=${LOAD_TEST_SECRET:-itms-staging-sim-secret}
    env_file:
      - .env
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health?liveness=1 || exit 1"]
      interval: 20s

    restart: unless-stopped
    deploy:

          memory: 1024M
    networks:

  nginx:

      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./nginx/certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
    depends_on:

      nextjs:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:

    image: prom/prometheus:v2.54.0
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - itms

  alertmanager:

    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.27.0

    volumes:

    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - itms

  grafana:

    ports:

    environment:

      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GF_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}

    volumes:

      - ./grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/dashboards:ro
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - itms

volumes:
```

#### nginx/nginx.conf (Edge Reverse Proxy, TLS Termination & WebSocket Upgrades)

**Exact Path:** file:///C:/Users/ADMIN/Desktop/Projects/ITMS/nginx/nginx.conf

```nginx
events {
  worker_connections  4096;
  multi_accept        on;
  use                 epoll;
}

http {
  # ── Security: hide server version ────────────────────────────────────────
  server_tokens off;
  client_max_body_size 10M;

  # ── Gzip Compression ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  gzip              on;
  gzip_vary         on;
  gzip_proxied      any;
  gzip_comp_level   6;
  gzip_types        text/plain text/css text/xml application/json application/javascript application/xml+rss application/atom+xml image/svg+xml;

  # ── SSL / TLS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ssl_protocols             TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
  ssl_ciphers               ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256;
  ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
  ssl_session_cache         shared:SSL:10m;
  ssl_session_timeout       1d;
  ssl_stapling              on;
  ssl_stapling_verify       on;

  # ── Security headers applied to all responses ────────────────────────────
  add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload" always;
  add_header X-Content-Type-Options    "nosniff"                                      always;
  add_header X-Frame-Options           "DENY"                                         always;
  add_header Referrer-Policy           "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"              always;
  add_header Permissions-Policy        "geolocation=(self), camera=(), microphone=()" always;

  # ── Upstream: WebSocket server (Single Process Realtime Runtime) ─────────
  upstream ws_backend {
    server ws1:3001 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;
    keepalive 256;
  }

  # ── Upstream: Next.js app (Round-robin / Stateless Compute) ─────────────
  # RATIONALE (Phase-03): Next.js app layer is stateless (auth via Firebase JWTs, state in Supabase).
  # Round-robin load balancing distributes traffic evenly across application compute nodes.
  upstream nextjs_backend {
    least_conn;
    server nextjs:3000 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;
    # For Multi-EC2 Application expansion, register additional nodes below:
    # server app-node-1.internal:3000 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;
    # server app-node-2.internal:3000 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;
    keepalive 64;
  }

  # ── Upstream: Health / Metrics (Internal Monitoring Routing) ────────────
  upstream health_backend {
    server ws1:9090 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;
    keepalive 16;
  }

  # ── HTTP → HTTPS redirect ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  server {
    listen      80;
    server_name itms.example.com localhost _;
    location /   { return 301 https://$host$request_uri; }
    location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { root /var/www/certbot; }
  }

  # ── HTTPS server ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  server {
    listen      443 ssl http2;
    server_name itms.example.com localhost _;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/certs/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/certs/privkey.pem;

    # ── WebSocket upgrade ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    location /ws {
      proxy_pass            http://ws_backend;
      proxy_http_version    1.1;
      proxy_set_header      Upgrade           $http_upgrade;
      proxy_set_header      Connection        "upgrade";
      proxy_set_header      Host              $host;
      proxy_set_header      X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
      proxy_set_header      X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
      proxy_set_header      X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
      proxy_set_header      X-Request-ID      $request_id;
      proxy_read_timeout    86400s;
      proxy_send_timeout    86400s;
      proxy_buffering off;
      proxy_cache off;
    }

    # ── Health endpoints ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Internal-only: accessible from Docker network and loopback.
    # Prometheus scrapes from within the same itms Docker bridge network.
    # External requests are denied with 403.
    location /health {
      # RFC1918 private ranges + loopback
      allow 127.0.0.1;
      allow 10.0.0.0/8;
      allow 172.16.0.0/12;
      allow 192.168.0.0/16;
      deny  all;

      proxy_pass         http://health_backend;
      proxy_http_version 1.1;
      proxy_set_header   Host $host;
      proxy_set_header   X-Request-ID $request_id;
    }

    # ── Prometheus metrics ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Internal-only: Prometheus container scrapes from within Docker network.
    # Never expose this endpoint to the public internet.
    location /metrics {
      allow 127.0.0.1;
      allow 10.0.0.0/8;
      allow 172.16.0.0/12;
      allow 192.168.0.0/16;
      deny  all;

      proxy_pass         http://health_backend;
      proxy_http_version 1.1;
      proxy_set_header   Host $host;
      proxy_set_header   X-Request-ID $request_id;
    }

    # ── Alertmanager webhook ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Internal-only: Prometheus Alertmanager notifies Next.js from within Docker network.
    location = /api/admin/alerts {
      allow 127.0.0.1;
      allow 10.0.0.0/8;
      allow 172.16.0.0/12;
      allow 192.168.0.0/16;
      deny  all;

      proxy_pass            http://nextjs_backend;
      proxy_http_version    1.1;
      proxy_set_header      Host              $host;
      proxy_set_header      X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
      proxy_set_header      X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
      proxy_set_header      X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
      proxy_set_header      X-Request-ID      $request_id;
    }

    # ── Next.js Prometheus metrics ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # Internal-only: Prometheus or internal monitoring scrapers only.
    location = /api/metrics {
      allow 127.0.0.1;
      allow 10.0.0.0/8;
      allow 172.16.0.0/12;
      allow 192.168.0.0/16;
      deny  all;

      proxy_pass            http://nextjs_backend;
      proxy_http_version    1.1;
      proxy_set_header      Host              $host;
      proxy_set_header      X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
      proxy_set_header      X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
      proxy_set_header      X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
      proxy_set_header      X-Request-ID      $request_id;
    }

    # ── Next.js app ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    location / {
      proxy_pass            http://nextjs_backend;
      proxy_http_version    1.1;
      proxy_set_header      Host              $host;
      proxy_set_header      X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
      proxy_set_header      X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
      proxy_set_header      X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
      proxy_set_header      X-Request-ID      $request_id;
      proxy_read_timeout    30s;
      proxy_connect_timeout 10s;
    }
  }
}
```

#### src/lib/supabase-server.ts (Server-Side Supabase Client Singleton & Connection Pool)

**Exact Path:** file:///C:/Users/ADMIN/Desktop/Projects/ITMS/src/lib/supabase-server.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Server-side Supabase Client Singleton
 * 
 * PERF: Reuses a single SupabaseClient instance w/ service-role key
 * across all API routes, avoiding the overhead of createClient() per request.
 * 
 * SECURITY: Uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY — NEVER import this in client code.
 */

import { createClient,SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

let _serverClient: SupabaseClient | null = null;

/**
 * Returns a singleton Supabase client for server-side (API route) usage.
 * Uses service-role key to bypass RLS for admin operations.
 */
export function getSupabaseServer(): SupabaseClient {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY;

  if (!url || !key) {
    // Return a Proxy that throws only when code attempts to access its properties/methods at runtime.
    // This allows module-level imports and instantiations to succeed during static Next.js compilation.
    return new Proxy({} as any, {
      get(target, prop) {
        throw new Error(
          `Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY env vars. Cannot access Supabase client property "${String(prop)}". Please restart your Next.js development server (npm run dev) to load updated environment variables.`
        );
      }
    });
  }

  if (!_serverClient) {
    _serverClient = createClient(url, key, {
      auth: {
        autoRefreshToken: false,
        persistSession: false,
      },
      global: {
        fetch: (input, init) => {
          return fetch(input, {
            ...init,
            signal: init?.signal || AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
          });
        },
      },
      // Disable realtime on server — we only need REST
      realtime: { params: { eventsPerSecond: 0 } },
    });
  }

  return _serverClient;
}
```

#### server/redis-client.ts (Resilient Native TCP/TLS Redis Client & RESP Parser)

**Exact Path:** file:///C:/Users/ADMIN/Desktop/Projects/ITMS/server/redis-client.ts

```typescript
import * as net from 'net';
import * as tls from 'tls';
import { logger } from './structured-logger';

export interface RedisClientOptions {
    url?: string;
    connectTimeoutMs?: number;
    reconnectIntervalMs?: number;
}

export class ResilientRedisClient {
    private clientSocket: net.Socket | tls.TLSSocket | null = null;
    private subSocket: net.Socket | tls.TLSSocket | null = null;
    private isConnected = false;
    private isSubConnected = false;
    private options: RedisClientOptions;
    private pubSubHandlers = new Map<string, Set<(message: string) => void>>();
    private reconnectTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    private generation = 0;
    private subGeneration = 0;
    private lastSubRecoveryAt = 0;
    private host = '127.0.0.1';
    private port = 6379;
    private isTls = false;
    private username?: string;
    private password?: string;

    constructor(options?: RedisClientOptions) {
        this.options = options || {};
        this.parseUrl(process.env.REDIS_URL || this.options.url);
    }

    private parseUrl(urlStr?: string) {
        if (!urlStr) return;
        try {
            const parsed = new URL(urlStr);
            this.host = parsed.hostname || '127.0.0.1';
            this.port = parseInt(parsed.port || (parsed.protocol === 'rediss:' ? '6379' : '6379'), 10);
            this.isTls = parsed.protocol === 'rediss:';
            if (parsed.username) {
                this.username = decodeURIComponent(parsed.username);
            }
            if (parsed.password) {
                this.password = decodeURIComponent(parsed.password);
            }
        } catch {
            logger.warn('redis_url_parse_failed', { url: urlStr });
        }
    }

    public async connect(): Promise<boolean> {
        if (!process.env.REDIS_URL && !this.options.url) {
            logger.info('redis_not_configured_using_memory_fallback');
            return false;
        }

        // Bump the generation before creating a new socket so callbacks from
        // any previous socket (error/close) are ignored — they must not clear
        // state or schedule reconnects for a socket we have already replaced.
        this.generation++;
        const gen = this.generation;
        if (this.clientSocket && !this.clientSocket.destroyed) this.clientSocket.destroy();

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            try {
                const onConnect = () => {
                    if (gen !== this.generation) return;
                    this.isConnected = true;
                    this.clientSocket?.setKeepAlive(true, 30000);
                    logger.info('redis_client_connected', { host: this.host, port: this.port });
                    if (this.password && this.clientSocket) {
                        const authCmd = (this.username && this.username !== 'default')
                            ? ['AUTH', this.username, this.password]
                            : ['AUTH', this.password];
                        this.sendCommand(this.clientSocket, authCmd);
                    }
                    resolve(true);
                };

                this.clientSocket = this.isTls
                    ? tls.connect({ host: this.host, port: this.port, servername: this.host }, onConnect)
                    : net.createConnection({ host: this.host, port: this.port }, onConnect);

                this.clientSocket.on('error', (err) => {
                    if (gen !== this.generation) return;
                    logger.warn('redis_client_error', { error: err.message });
                    this.isConnected = false;
                    this.scheduleReconnect();
                    resolve(false);
                });

                this.clientSocket.on('close', () => {
                    if (gen !== this.generation) return;
                    this.isConnected = false;
                    this.scheduleReconnect();
                });

                this.initSubSocket();
            } catch (err) {
                if (gen !== this.generation) return;
                logger.warn('redis_connection_exception', { error: (err as Error).message });
                this.scheduleReconnect();
                resolve(false);
            }
        });
    }

    private initSubSocket() {
        // Replacing an old sub socket invalidates its callbacks via subGeneration.
        this.subGeneration++;
        const gen = this.subGeneration;
        if (this.subSocket && !this.subSocket.destroyed) this.subSocket.destroy();

        try {
            const onConnect = () => {
                if (gen !== this.subGeneration) return;
                this.isSubConnected = true;
                this.subSocket?.setKeepAlive(true, 30000);

                // W10: Pipeline AUTH + all channel SUBSCRIBEs into a single TCP write
                let pipeline = '';
                if (this.password) {
                    const authCmd = (this.username && this.username !== 'default')
                        ? ['AUTH', this.username, this.password]
                        : ['AUTH', this.password];
                    pipeline += this.encodeCommand(authCmd);
                }
                for (const channel of this.pubSubHandlers.keys()) {
                    pipeline += this.encodeCommand(['SUBSCRIBE', channel]);
                }
                if (pipeline && this.subSocket && !this.subSocket.destroyed) {
                    this.subSocket.write(pipeline);
                }
            };

            this.subSocket = this.isTls
                ? tls.connect({ host: this.host, port: this.port, servername: this.host }, onConnect)
                : net.createConnection({ host: this.host, port: this.port }, onConnect);

            let subBuffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
            this.subSocket.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
                if (gen !== this.subGeneration) return;
                subBuffer = Buffer.from(Buffer.concat([subBuffer, chunk]));
                subBuffer = Buffer.from(this.parseRespMessages(subBuffer));
            });

            this.subSocket.on('error', (err) => {
                if (gen !== this.subGeneration) return;
                logger.warn('redis_sub_socket_error', { error: err.message });
                this.isSubConnected = false;
            });

            this.subSocket.on('close', () => {
                if (gen !== this.subGeneration) return;
                this.isSubConnected = false;
                // If the client socket is healthy, recover the sub socket and
                // resubscribe all channels. Rate-limited to avoid a hot loop
                // when Redis keeps dropping the subscription connection.
                const now = Date.now();
                if (this.isConnected && now - this.lastSubRecoveryAt > 2000) {
                    this.lastSubRecoveryAt = now;
                    logger.warn('redis_sub_socket_closed_recovering');
                    this.initSubSocket();
                }
            });
        } catch {
            this.isSubConnected = false;
        }
    }

    private parseRespMessages(buffer: Buffer): Buffer {
        let offset = 0;

        const parseElement = (pos: number): { value: string | number | null; nextPos: number } | null => {
            if (pos >= buffer.length) return null;
            const prefix = buffer[pos];
            const crlf = buffer.indexOf('\r\n', pos);
            if (crlf === -1) return null;

            if (prefix === 0x24) { // '$' bulk string
                const len = parseInt(buffer.toString('utf8', pos + 1, crlf), 10);
                if (len === -1) {
                    return { value: null, nextPos: crlf + 2 };
                }
                const end = crlf + 2 + len;
                if (end + 2 > buffer.length) return null;
                const str = buffer.toString('utf8', crlf + 2, end);
                return { value: str, nextPos: end + 2 };
            } else if (prefix === 0x3a) { // ':' integer
                const val = parseInt(buffer.toString('utf8', pos + 1, crlf), 10);
                return { value: val, nextPos: crlf + 2 };
            } else if (prefix === 0x2b || prefix === 0x2d) { // '+' simple string, '-' error
                const str = buffer.toString('utf8', pos + 1, crlf);
                return { value: str, nextPos: crlf + 2 };
            }
            return null;
        };

        while (offset < buffer.length) {
            if (buffer[offset] !== 0x2a) { // '*'
                const nextStar = buffer.indexOf('*', offset + 1);
                if (nextStar === -1) return Buffer.alloc(0);
                offset = nextStar;
            }

            const crlf1 = buffer.indexOf('\r\n', offset);
            if (crlf1 === -1) break;

            const numElements = parseInt(buffer.toString('utf8', offset + 1, crlf1), 10);
            let curr = crlf1 + 2;

            if (numElements < 0) {
                offset = curr;
                continue;
            }

            const elem1 = parseElement(curr);
            if (!elem1) break;

            if (elem1.value === 'message' && numElements === 3) {
                const elem2 = parseElement(elem1.nextPos);
                if (!elem2) break;

                const elem3 = parseElement(elem2.nextPos);
                if (!elem3) break;

                offset = elem3.nextPos;
                const channel = String(elem2.value);
                const message = String(elem3.value);

                const handlers = this.pubSubHandlers.get(channel);
                if (handlers) {
                    for (const handler of handlers) {
                        try { handler(message); } catch { }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                let nextPos = elem1.nextPos;
                let incomplete = false;
                for (let i = 1; i < numElements; i++) {
                    const elem = parseElement(nextPos);
                    if (!elem) {
                        incomplete = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    nextPos = elem.nextPos;
                }
                if (incomplete) break;
                offset = nextPos;
            }
        }
        return buffer.subarray(offset);
    }

    private scheduleReconnect() {
        if (this.reconnectTimer) return;
        const jitterMs = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2000);
        this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.reconnectTimer = null;
            this.connect();
        }, 5000 + jitterMs);
    }

    private encodeCommand(args: string[]): string {
        let command = `*${args.length}\r\n`;
        for (const arg of args) {
            command += `$${Buffer.byteLength(arg)}\r\n${arg}\r\n`;
        }
        return command;
    }

    private sendCommand(socket: net.Socket, args: string[]) {
        if (!socket || socket.destroyed) return;
        socket.write(this.encodeCommand(args));
    }

    public async publish(channel: string, message: string): Promise<void> {
        if (this.isConnected && this.clientSocket) {
            this.sendCommand(this.clientSocket, ['PUBLISH', channel, message]);
        }
    }

    public async subscribe(channel: string, handler: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {
        let handlers = this.pubSubHandlers.get(channel);
        if (!handlers) {
            handlers = new Set();
            this.pubSubHandlers.set(channel, handlers);
            if (this.isSubConnected && this.subSocket) {
                this.sendCommand(this.subSocket, ['SUBSCRIBE', channel]);
            }
        }
        handlers.add(handler);
    }

    public async unsubscribe(channel: string): Promise<void> {
        this.pubSubHandlers.delete(channel);
        if (this.isSubConnected && this.subSocket) {
            this.sendCommand(this.subSocket, ['UNSUBSCRIBE', channel]);
        }
    }

    public isReady(): boolean {
        return this.isConnected;
    }
}

export const redisClient = new ResilientRedisClient();
```

```typescript
import type { PubSubAdapter } from '../src/domains/realtime/pubsub';
import { redisClient } from './redis-client';

export class RedisPubSub implements PubSubAdapter {
  async publish(channel: string, message: string): Promise<void> {
    if (redisClient.isReady()) {
      await redisClient.publish(channel, message);
    }
  }

  async subscribe(channel: string, handler: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {
    if (redisClient.isReady()) {
      await redisClient.subscribe(channel, handler);
    }
  }

  async unsubscribe(channel: string): Promise<void> {
    if (redisClient.isReady()) {
      await redisClient.unsubscribe(channel);
    }
  }
}

export const redisPubSub = new RedisPubSub();
```

#### server/redis-broadcast.ts (Redis Cross-Process Security Listener & Eviction Bridge)

**Exact Path:** file:///C:/Users/ADMIN/Desktop/Projects/ITMS/server/redis-broadcast.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Redis Broadcast Bridge
 *
 * Wires Redis Pub/Sub into the WebSocket broadcast path for multi-node support.
 *
 * Architecture:
 *   - All WS nodes subscribe to REDIS_BROADCAST_CHANNEL on startup.
 *   - When any node originates a broadcast (from a driver's GPS update or
 *     a server-side event), it:
 *       1. Broadcasts locally to its own in-process subscribers immediately.
 *       2. Publishes to Redis so every OTHER node can relay it.
 *   - Receiving nodes check originNodeId and skip their own echoes.
 *
 * No circular imports:
 *   - This module does NOT import websocket-server or socket-router at module
 *     level. Callbacks are injected at init time (inversion of control).
 *
 * No-loop guarantee:
 *   - Each message carries originNodeId (crypto UUID assigned once at startup).
 *   - Receiving nodes skip messages where originNodeId === MY_NODE_ID.
 *
 * Graceful degradation:
 *   - If Redis is not configured, redisPubSub calls are no-ops.
 *   - Single-node in-process broadcast continues unchanged.
 */

import crypto from 'crypto';
import { redisPubSub } from './redis-pubsub';
import { logger } from './structured-logger';
import { invalidateTokenAuthCache } from './authenticator';
import { sessionManager } from './session-manager';
import { connectionRegistry } from './connection-registry';
import { metricsService } from './metrics-service';

/** Unique identifier for this WS server process. Never changes after startup. */
export const MY_NODE_ID = crypto.randomUUID();

/** Redis channel all WS nodes listen on for cross-node broadcasts. */
const REDIS_BROADCAST_CHANNEL = 'ws:broadcast';
const ROLE_INVALIDATE_CHANNEL = 'role_invalidate';
const ROLE_INVALIDATE_CHANNEL_ALT = 'itms:roles:invalidate';

interface BroadcastEnvelope {
  /** The WS channel to broadcast on (e.g. 'bus:ABC', 'trip-status-BUS123') */
  channel: string;
  /** The event name (e.g. 'bus_location_update', 'trip_ended') */
  event: string;
  /** Arbitrary payload */
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** Node that originated this message — receivers skip if it matches MY_NODE_ID */
  originNodeId: string;
}

/**
 * In the simplified single-process WebSocket architecture, all client subscribers
 * connect to this single WS runtime instance. Local in-process broadcast is already
 * completed synchronously before calling publishToRedis.
 *
 * Cross-node relay via Redis Pub/Sub (ws:broadcast) is bypassed to eliminate
 * redundant network roundtrips, serialization, and Redis pub/sub load.
 */
export function publishToRedis(
  _channel: string,
  _event: string,
  _payload: Record<string, unknown>
): void {
  // Bypassed: single-process WS runtime does not require cross-node relay.
  // Preserved as zero-overhead no-op.
}

/**
 * Initializes Redis listeners required for system security and state coordination.
 * In single-process WS mode, cross-node broadcast relay is bypassed, while
 * cross-process role invalidation (`role_invalidate`) is strictly preserved
 * to evict demoted or revoked users across application boundaries.
 */
export async function initRedisBroadcastRelay(
  _onBroadcast?: (channel: string, event: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) => void,
  _onLocationUpdate?: (busId: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) => void,
  _onTripEnded?: (busId: string) => void,
): Promise<void> {
  // Cross-node role invalidation listener: purges cached JWT auth and terminates
  // active sessions in this WS instance whenever an admin updates user permissions or roles.
  const handleRoleInvalidation = (rawUid: string) => {
    const uid = rawUid ? rawUid.trim() : undefined;
    invalidateTokenAuthCache(uid);

    // Evict cached student presence to reflect reassignment or privilege change immediately
    import('./socket-router')
      .then((m) => m.clearStudentPresenceCache(uid))
      .catch(() => {});

    if (uid) {
      const activeSessions = sessionManager.getByUid(uid);
      for (const session of activeSessions) {
        const conn = connectionRegistry.get(session.socketId);
        if (conn) {
          try {
            conn.ws.close(4401, 'Role revoked or permissions modified - please re-authenticate');
          } catch (err) {
            logger.warn('ws_close_on_revoke_error', { socketId: session.socketId, error: (err as Error).message });
          }
          connectionRegistry.unregister(session.socketId);
        }
        sessionManager.delete(session.socketId);
      }
      logger.info('ws_active_sessions_revoked', { uid, count: activeSessions.length });
    } else {
      for (const [socketId, conn] of connectionRegistry.getAll().entries()) {
        try {
          conn.ws.close(4401, 'Global permissions modified - please re-authenticate');
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
        connectionRegistry.unregister(socketId);
        sessionManager.delete(socketId);
      }
      logger.info('ws_all_sessions_revoked');
    }

    logger.info('ws_role_cache_invalidated', { uid: uid || 'all' });
  };

  const handleStudentAssignInvalidation = (rawUid: string) => {
    const uid = rawUid ? rawUid.trim() : undefined;
    import('./socket-router')
      .then((m) => m.clearStudentPresenceCache(uid === '*' ? undefined : uid))
      .catch(() => {});

    if (uid && uid !== '*') {
      const activeSessions = sessionManager.getByUid(uid);
      for (const session of activeSessions) {
        const conn = connectionRegistry.get(session.socketId);
        if (conn) {
          try {
            conn.ws.close(4402, 'Student assignment or transport entitlement updated - reconnecting');
          } catch (err) {
            logger.warn('ws_close_on_reassign_error', { socketId: session.socketId, error: (err as Error).message });
          }
          connectionRegistry.unregister(session.socketId);
        }
        sessionManager.delete(session.socketId);
      }
      logger.info('ws_student_sessions_evicted', { uid, count: activeSessions.length });
    } else {
      let closedCount = 0;
      for (const [socketId, conn] of connectionRegistry.getAll().entries()) {
        const session = sessionManager.get(socketId);
        if (session && session.role === 'student') {
          try {
            conn.ws.close(4402, 'Student assignment or transport entitlement updated - reconnecting');
          } catch { /* ignore */ }
          connectionRegistry.unregister(socketId);
          sessionManager.delete(socketId);
          closedCount++;
        }
      }
      logger.info('ws_all_student_sessions_evicted', { count: closedCount });
    }

    logger.info('ws_student_presence_cache_invalidated', { uid: uid || 'all' });
  };

  await redisPubSub.subscribe(ROLE_INVALIDATE_CHANNEL, handleRoleInvalidation);
  await redisPubSub.subscribe(ROLE_INVALIDATE_CHANNEL_ALT, handleRoleInvalidation);
  await redisPubSub.subscribe('student_assign_invalidate', handleStudentAssignInvalidation);

  logger.info('redis_security_listeners_initialized', {
    nodeId: MY_NODE_ID,
    roleInvalidateChannel: ROLE_INVALIDATE_CHANNEL,
    roleInvalidateChannelAlt: ROLE_INVALIDATE_CHANNEL_ALT,
    studentAssignInvalidateChannel: 'student_assign_invalidate',
    broadcastRelay: 'bypassed_single_node',
  });
}
```

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { wsServer } from './websocket-server';
import { logger } from './structured-logger';
import { healthService } from './health-service';
import { metricsService } from './metrics-service';
import { stopOfflineQueue } from './offline-queue';
import { stopRateLimiter } from './rate-limiter';
import { stopMessageValidator } from './message-validator';
import { validateEnvironment } from '../src/lib/env-validator';
import { redisClient } from './redis-client';
import { initRedisBroadcastRelay } from './redis-broadcast';

import { assertPrivilegedTokenSafe } from './authenticator';

const WS_PORT = parseInt(process.env.PORT || process.env.WS_PORT || '3001', 10);
const HEALTH_PORT = parseInt(process.env.HEALTH_PORT || '9090', 10);

async function main() {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    try {
      assertPrivilegedTokenSafe();
    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.error('startup_blocked_insecure_token', { error: err.message });
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }

  const envCheck = validateEnvironment({ isWebSocketServer: true });
  if (!envCheck.valid && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    logger.error('startup_blocked_invalid_environment', { missing: envCheck.missing });
    process.exit(1);
  }
  if (!process.env.FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL || !process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    logger.warn('Firebase Admin credentials not found; auth will reject all connections', { port: WS_PORT });
  }

  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    // Health probe responder on main server port (for Render, Railway, and external keep-alive crons)
    const rawUrl = req.url?.split('?')[0];
    if (rawUrl === '/health' || rawUrl === '/health/live' || rawUrl === '/') {
      const status = healthService.liveness();
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      res.writeHead(status.status === 'ok' ? 200 : 503);
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: status.status, service: 'itms-ws-server', uptime: status.uptime }));
      return;
    }
    if (rawUrl === '/health/ready') {
      const status = healthService.readiness();
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      res.writeHead(status.status === 'ok' ? 200 : 503);
      res.end(JSON.stringify(status));
      return;
    }
    if (rawUrl === '/metrics') {
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/plain; charset=utf-8');
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      res.writeHead(200);
      res.end(metricsService.prometheus());
      return;
    }
    if (rawUrl === '/metrics/json') {
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      res.writeHead(200);
      res.end(JSON.stringify(metricsService.snapshot()));
      return;
    }
  });
  wsServer.start(server);

  // Connect Redis and initialize cross-process security listener (role_invalidate).
  // Graceful: if REDIS_URL is absent, redisClient.connect() returns false
  // and redisPubSub calls become no-ops.
  redisClient.connect().then((connected) => {
    if (connected) {
      initRedisBroadcastRelay().catch((err) => {
        logger.warn('redis_security_listener_init_failed', { error: (err as Error).message });
      });
    } else {
      logger.info('redis_not_configured_running_standalone');
    }
  });

  server.listen(WS_PORT, () => {
    logger.info('websocket_runtime_started', { port: WS_PORT });
  });

  const healthServer = createServer((req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');

    if (req.url === '/health/live') {
      const status = healthService.liveness();
      res.writeHead(status.status === 'ok' ? 200 : 503);
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: status.status, uptime: status.uptime }));
    } else if (req.url === '/health/ready') {
      const status = healthService.readiness();
      res.writeHead(status.status === 'ok' ? 200 : 503);
      res.end(JSON.stringify(status));
    } else if (req.url === '/health/startup') {
      healthService.startup().then((status) => {
        res.writeHead(status.status === 'ok' ? 200 : 503);
        res.end(JSON.stringify(status));
      }).catch(() => {
        res.writeHead(503);
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: 'error' }));
      });
      return;
    } else if (req.url === '/health') {
      res.writeHead(200);
      res.end(JSON.stringify(healthService.liveness()));
    } else if (req.url === '/metrics') {
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/plain; charset=utf-8');
      res.writeHead(200);
      res.end(metricsService.prometheus());
    } else if (req.url === '/metrics/json') {
      res.writeHead(200);
      res.end(JSON.stringify(metricsService.snapshot()));
    } else {
      res.writeHead(404);
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'not_found' }));
    }
  });

  if (HEALTH_PORT !== WS_PORT) {
    healthServer.listen(HEALTH_PORT, () => {
      logger.info('health_server_started', { port: HEALTH_PORT });
    });
  }

  const shutdown = async (signal: string) => {
    logger.info('shutdown_started', { signal, drainTimeout: 30000 });

    healthService.startShutdown();
    healthService.startDraining();

    const drainTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      logger.warn('drain_timeout_reached', { elapsed: healthService.getDrainElapsed() });
      forceExit();
    }, 30000);

    wsServer.shutdown(() => {
      clearTimeout(drainTimer);
      healthService.stopDraining();
      stopOfflineQueue();
      stopRateLimiter();
      stopMessageValidator();
      forceExit();
    });
  };

  const forceExit = () => {
    logger.info('shutdown_complete');
    process.exit(0);
  };

  process.on('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));
  process.on('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));
  process.on('uncaughtException', (err) => {
    logger.error('uncaught_exception', { error: err.message, stack: err.stack });
  });
  process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) => {
    logger.error('unhandled_rejection', { reason: String(reason) });
  });
}

main().catch(err => {
  logger.error('fatal_error', { error: (err as Error).message, stack: (err as Error).stack });
  process.exit(1);
});

```
